title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-27 00:53:41 最新章节：第五十八章 创造出了巫师层次的新公式
slug: 从巫师学徒到万界征服者
content_zh:
“嘭！嘭！嘭！”
上百双羊皮靴，接连踏过由一块块黑曜石地板铺就的地面。
廊道两侧整齐排列的石柱表面，蚀刻的符文蛇行蜿蜒，泛着神秘的银色辉光。
莫宁穿着样式统一的蓝袍，身体随着人流机械地向前移动。
他谨慎地控制着自己的视线，没有左顾右盼，亦不会在某件物品上停留太久。
这是他在这个世界学会的第一课：过度的好奇心可能招致死亡，而恰当的低调，反而是最好的护身符。
当初在圣枪王国，他亲眼目睹一名女仆多触碰了几下某个巫术物品，结果右手瞬间燃烧起来，而宫廷女官只是冷漠说道：“将这个蠢货送回去。”
而在王国的王室图书馆，一位老人曾微笑着告诉他：“我观察你半个月了，你始终谨言慎行，不像其他被选中者那样张扬，这很难得，这说明你有非常清醒的头脑，以及强大的自控力。”
新人队伍继续前行。
这支由268人组成的队伍，来自黑塔巫师学院势力范围内的七个王国。
所有人皆在15岁那年，通过了“精神共振”测试。
当额头贴上灵能水晶之时，水晶泛起的幽光证明了他们超出常人的精神天赋。
在各个王国，他们是令人羡慕的被选中者。
但在黑塔学院，他们只是最底层的新人。
因为天赋，仅仅是踏入巫师世界的门票。
“你们进入巫师学院后，如果想要留下来。”负责测试的学徒当时语气充满了冷漠，“必须努力修炼《基础冥想法》，两年内在灵魂深处凝聚出‘灵环’。”
灵环，是巫师力量的基石。
没有灵环，永远无法施展巫术。
“凝聚灵环的速度，决定天资的高下。”学徒神情淡漠地补充，“超过两年仍旧未能凝聚灵环，便是废物。”
他顿了顿，吐出最后一句：“而学院，从不收容废物。”

过了数秒。
队伍前方忽然传来压抑的惊叹声，像水波般向后扩散。
“看上面，天哪！”
“屋顶去哪了？”
“这就是巫术吗？”
莫宁终于按捺不住，小幅度地仰起了头。
只看了一眼，他便呆住了。
因为上方根本没有屋顶。
唯有一片凝固的、纯粹的、深不见底的黑暗。
光线触及它的边缘时发生诡异的扭曲，仿佛正被那黑暗无声地吞噬。
“安静。”
一个平淡的声音响起，不高，却清晰地压过了所有私语。
这支新人队伍的最前方，身着灰袍的领路学徒转过身来。
他约莫30岁，面容苍白瘦削，深陷的眼窝里嵌着一对灰色的瞳孔。
瞳孔内没有温度，只有审视。
他的袍袖右胸绣着两道银线，这是二级学徒的标志。
此人名叫莱特，之前曾简短地自我介绍过，负责引导新人进入学院。
“这是【永夜天幕】。”
莱特的声音在廊道中清晰地传开。
“这是恒久固化的三级巫术，自黑塔建立之初便高悬于此，迄今为止已守护学院1327年。”
content_en:
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
Hundreds of pairs of sheepskin boots stepped on the ground paved with obsidian floors.
On the surface of the neatly arranged stone pillars on both sides of the corridor, the etched runes snake and snake, glowing with a mysterious silver glow.
Mourning wore a uniform blue robe, and his body moved forward mechanically with the flow of people.
He carefully controlled his gaze, neither looking left nor right, nor staying on an item for too long.
This was the first lesson he learned in this world: excessive curiosity may lead to death, while appropriate low-keyness is the best talisman.
Back in the Holy Spear Kingdom, he witnessed a maid touching a certain witchcraft object a few times too many times, causing her right hand to instantly burn. The palace lady just said indifferently: "Send this idiot back."
In the royal library of the kingdom, an old man once told him with a smile: "I have been observing you for half a month. You are always cautious in your words and deeds. You are not as flamboyant as other selected people. This is rare. This shows that you have a very clear mind and strong self-control."
The team of newcomers moved on.
This team of 268 people comes from the seven kingdoms within the influence of the Black Tower Wizard Academy.
All of them passed the "spiritual resonance" test when they were 15 years old.
When the psychic crystal is placed on their foreheads, the dim light cast by the crystal proves their spiritual talents beyond ordinary people.
In every kingdom, they are the envied chosen ones.
But in Black Tower Academy, they are just the newcomers at the bottom.
Because talent is just the ticket to enter the wizarding world.
"After you enter the wizard academy, if you want to stay." The apprentice in charge of the test said in a cold tone, "You must work hard to practice the "Basic Meditation Method" and condense a 'spiritual ring' deep in your soul within two years."
The spirit ring is the cornerstone of a wizard's power.
Without a spirit ring, witchcraft can never be performed.
"The speed of condensing the spirit ring determines the level of talent." The apprentice added indifferently, "If you have not been able to condensate the spirit ring for more than two years, you are a waste."
He paused and uttered the last sentence: "And the academy never accepts waste."
A few seconds passed.
A suppressed exclamation suddenly came from the front of the team, spreading backwards like water waves.
"Look up there, oh my God!"
“Where did the roof go?”
"Is this witchcraft?"
Mourning finally couldn't hold back anymore and raised his head slightly.
After just one glance, he froze.
Because there is no roof above.
There is only a solid, pure, bottomless darkness.
The light twisted strangely when it touched its edge, as if it was being swallowed silently by the darkness.
"Quiet."
A plain voice sounded, not loud, but clearly overpowering all the whispers.
At the front of the new team, the leading apprentice in gray robe turned around.
He was about 30 years old, with a pale and thin face, and a pair of gray pupils embedded in his deep-set eye sockets.
There is no temperature in the pupils, only scrutiny.
His robe sleeves were embroidered with two lines of silver thread on the right chest, which was the mark of a second-level apprentice.
This man's name was Wright, who had briefly introduced himself before, and was responsible for guiding newcomers into the academy.
"This is [Eternal Night Sky Curtain]."
Wright's voice sounded clearly in the corridor.
"This is a long-lasting third-level witchcraft. It has been hanging here since the establishment of the Black Tower. It has protected the academy for 1327 years so far."
